view.governing_question: What is the most complete account of this black-box component, given the single observation that 'a' is answered '0'?
view.closure_assumption: The finite observation list is treated as the complete account of the component; this closure is restated as a play of complementary aspects rather than withdrawn in favour of a runnable process.
view.polar_view: source and behavior are complementary manifestations of the program's underlying identity, each expressing the whole through its own aspect
view.named_obstruction: the tension between the seen and the unseen is dissolved by recognising each observation as one facet of a single indivisible identity
